dict.string: 30-min cache-write walker for /token/<cur>/<iss>. Enumerates DISTINCT issuers from token_volume via db.read_token_volume_issuers() and fetches AccountInfo(signer_lists=True) per issuer via LAN rippled (XRPL_LOCAL_NODE), upserting into token_issuer_flags_snapshot in Neon. The /token route reads that table for its "Ledger-level capabilities" panel instead of firing one live AccountInfo RPC per page render. Wired 2026-09-06 to kill ~3/day walker_node_fallback rows for walker_name=token_page. StartInterval per macos_startinterval_over_calendar rule (rolling — fires on wake if the interval has elapsed). Issuer flags change rarely (a manual AccountSet tx); 30-min cadence gives 3 write cycles inside the 90-min staleness threshold so one missed fire is invisible.
